A native of {{ill|Mie Prefecture|en|Mie Prefecture|qid=Q128196|lt=Mie Prefecture}}, he graduated from {{ill|Kokugakuin University|en|Kokugakuin University|qid=Q495330|lt=Kokugakuin University}} and studied under {{ill|Naokazu Miyaji|ja|宮地直一|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyaji Naoki|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11453535}}. Before World War II, he worked as a researcher at the {{ill|Okura Institute for the Study of Spiritual Culture|ja|大倉精神文化研究所|qid=Q11432442}} and as a lecturer at {{ill|University of Tokyo|af|Universiteit van Tokio|ar|جامعة طوكيو|arz|جامعة طوكيو|ast|Universidá de Tokiu|az|Tokio Universiteti|azb|توکیو بیلیم‌یوردو|ba|Токио университеты|ban|Univérsitas Tokyo|be|Такійскі ўніверсітэт|be_x_old|Такійскі ўнівэрсытэт|bg|Токийски университет|bn|টোকিও বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়|br|Skol-veur Tokyo|ca|Universitat de Tòquio|cdo|東京大學|cs|Tokijská univerzita|de|Universität Tokio|el|Πανεπιστήμιο του Τόκιο|eo|Universitato de Tokio|es|Universidad de Tokio|et|Tokyo Ülikool|eu|Tokioko Unibertsitatea|fa|دانشگاه توکیو|fi|Tokion yliopisto|fr|Université de Tokyo|gl|Universidade de Tokyo|he|אוניברסיטת טוקיו|hi|टोक्यो विश्वविद्यालय|hr|Sveučilište u Tokiju|hu|Tokiói Egyetem|hy|Տոկիոյի համալսարան|id|Universitas Tokyo|it|Università imperiale di Tokyo|ja|東京大学|ka|ტოკიოს უნივერსიტეტი|kk|Токио университеті|ko|도쿄 대학|la|Universitas Tokiensis|lt|Tokijo universitetas|lv|Tokijas Universitāte|mad|Universitas Tokyo|ml|ടോക്കിയോ സർവകലാശാല|mn|Токиогийн Их Сургууль|ms|Universiti Tokyo|my|တိုကျို တက္ကသိုလ်|ne|टोकियो विश्वविद्यालय|nl|Universiteit van Tokio|no|Universitetet i Tokyo|pa|ਟੋਕੀਓ ਯੂਨੀਵਰਸਿਟੀ|pl|Uniwersytet Tokijski|pnb|یونیورسٹی آف ٹوکیو|pt|Universidade de Tóquio|qu|Tokyo Yachay Sunturnin|ro|Universitatea Tokio|ru|Токийский университет|sco|Varsity o Tokyo|sh|Univerzitet u Tokiju|simple|University of Tokyo|sk|Tokijská univerzita|sl|Univerza v Tokiu|sr|Универзитет у Токију|sv|Tokyos universitet|ta|டோக்கியோ பல்கலைக்கழகம்|te|టోక్యో విశ్వవిద్యాలయం|tg|Донишгоҳи Токио|th|มหาวิทยาลัยโตเกียว|tl|Unibersidad ng Tokyo|tr|Tokyo Üniversitesi|tt|Токио университеты|ug|توكيو ئۇنىۋېرستېتى|uk|Токійський університет|ur|جامعہ ٹوکیو|uz|Tokio universiteti|vi|Đại học Tokyo|war|Unibersidad han Tokyo|wuu|东京大学|za|Dunghgingh Dayoz|zh|东京大学|zh_min_nan|Tang-kiaⁿ Tāi-ha̍k|zh_yue|東京大學|qid=Q7842}}; after the war, he served as a professor at {{ill|Kokugakuin University|en|Kokugakuin University|qid=Q495330|lt=Kokugakuin University}}. In 1955, with his paper “A Preliminary Discussion on the Origin of Japanese Religions” (『日本宗教の発生に関する一試論』), he was awarded a Doctorate in Literature by Kokugakuin University.
